title: GUI provenance audit: unsupported assumptions and research dispatch after v0.8.2
body:
Owner requested a GPT-6.1 Sol agent at high reasoning to audit remake implementation for unsupported original-behavior assumptions, especially GUI. This issue preserves the resulting research questions and distinctions; status belongs on GitHub, not a repository snapshot.

Audit scope: static read-only inspection of battle presentation/interactions, recruitment, supply/transfers/split, diplomacy, file flows and settings at remake [4d70275a](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/tree/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908), checked against promoted research [865755e0](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/tree/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6). The parent session verified the concrete supply-report limits, tactical click prose and recruitment-default conflict, and checked existing open issues before filing. No original-game run, visual comparison, new experiment or implementation was performed. This is a bounded first-pass audit, not a claim that all remaining GUI behavior has been proved.

New research tasks, in suggested order:

1. [#80 Tactical enemy-click selection and attack precedence](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/issues/80): own-only selection is implemented; original report's “select a unit” and adjacent-enemy attack branches need an exact precedence/inspection matrix.
2. [#81 Recruitment initial city / All cities selection](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/issues/81): first-listed/All cities implementation versus older capital/most-training prose; reconcile newer T162 behavior and source claims.
3. [#78 Supply multi-provider ordering, caps and selection](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/issues/78): state-order uncapped query versus original code-reading limits; multiple-provider runtime behavior explicitly unestablished.
4. [#79 Supply army through a selected carrier fleet](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/issues/79): army target/provider coordinates/account routing need the original selected-fleet branch control.

These are evidence gaps or ambiguities, not four confirmed bugs. Each child contains pinned implementation/report links and a bounded original-side experiment.

Existing implementation discrepancies / follow-ups: reuse their issues and findings before requesting additional research:

- [build #732](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/732): human-human post-battle payment window. TacticalBattleSession.cs:560 omits an offer because the original writes no relation, but the promoted [peace-path report §4](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/decompiled-war-cascade-and-peace-paths.md) says THVHBatPols_OK transfers agreed money. No relation write does not imply no monetary effect. Basic omission is already researched; only exact spinner/payer/Cancel/hotseat details may need further controls.
- [build #918](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/918): fleet build-port choice. Some comments still call it open despite promoted nearest-capital evidence. This needs source reconciliation/implementation intake, not rediscovery.
- [build #723](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/723): cosmetic controls and related Supply opening differences. The supply report already documents silent no-provider and directional fleet lookup. Audit saw OpenSupplyFleetDialog always open for a selected owned fleet. Check existing task scope before filing a correction.
- [build #1010](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1010): selected-object recolor/rhombus marker; [#720](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/720): missing original shortcuts; [#722](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/722): help/reference pages. These already have original-side evidence.
- T219 / [build #1456](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1456) already distinguishes faithful manual treasury funding in debt from explicit purse-source QoL; do not reclassify that account picker as an accidental original-rule claim.

Interpretations deliberately outside defect claims:

- Owner-approved layout, compact lists, allegiance colors/contrast, adjustable pauses (current fresh defaults 0.1s shots / 0.2s attacks), travel animation/pacing, balanced whole-unit Split in two, live resource displays, automation/Retreat and supply/rally modes, and army supply providers are remake design/QoL. Original evidence is not their acceptance criterion.
- TacticalBattleViewModel.cs:561 clamps morale words outside the six-word table as an explicit designed safeguard. Original high/low morale display could be measured later; the audit does not establish a defect or authorize unsafe out-of-table replication.
- Current ParticipantLines withholds enemy morale/moves/shots. No demonstrated enemy-information leak was found.
- Existing promoted information-panel/band research is substantial; absence of a local inline citation alone is not proof of unsupported implementation.

Next research sessions should take individual child tasks, read current promoted findings first, and return exact original behavior with scope/provenance. Remake correction or intentional divergence is a separate decision after evidence intake. No release gate or milestone is changed by this audit.
